title: Amount Charged for a Cash Pickup Name Correction
content:
**Note to the Cash Pickup pricing schedule.** The name-correction fee on a Cash Pickup transfer is the full name-correction fee of the transfer's tier, charged as it stands.

The amount is read from the transfer's own tier in the Cash Pickup tier schedule. The whole listed fee is charged, in US dollars and cents. It is charged on each correction beyond the tier's free corrections, and each such correction is charged the same listed amount.

*Hypothetical listed fees.* A tier listing 5.00 charges 5.00 on a correction beyond the free ones, a tier listing 10.00 charges 10.00, and a tier listing 0.00 charges 0.00.
